title: Virtual Compute: outage claim filing period
content:
## Meaning — outage claim filing period

Virtual Compute outage claim filing period: Inclusive outage-claim filing period after the incident closes; calendar days integer.

## Tier values — outage claim filing period

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — outage claim filing period: 30.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for outage claim filing period?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has outage claim filing period of 30.
